newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stocks expected to move lower on weak overseas.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks expected to move lower on weak overseas.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks are seen moving lower on Thursday following easier overseas markets and ahead of U.S. employment figures due on Friday, brokers said.
"The Hang Seng is likely to open easier after the weaker closes on Wall Street and other overseas markets last night," said Michael Ng, dealing director at Sassoon Securities.
Institutional buyers were likely to take a breather with the blue-chip index seen falling 100-150 points today, he said.
The Hang Seng Index rose 71.41 points to close at 14,831.58 on Wednesday. Later the Hang Seng London Reference Index eased 29.97 points to close at 14,801.61.
